data: Existing train600 five-fold development replay. Every original question is held out exactly once. All evaluations share its 20 combinations and 3 cached generations.
bbh_weighting: per question for primary metrics; subtask results separate

sky.operator: Reuse E26 neighbor_scores on frozen MiniLM embeddings and historical integer success counts
sky.first: first exact maximum in physical action order
sky.P: maximum fold-history success count restricted to exact maxima; uniform on remaining ties

fixed: Action with maximum fold-history success count; first frozen physical action if tied

ridge.features: Original E8 PCA16(full), StandardScaler, penalized constant; fitted within every training split
ridge.inner_protocol: Original E8 three-way splits stratified by task/subtask with seed 20261113 + outer fold; compare row arrays with saved M0_tuned logs
ridge.training: Original SVD ridge weights with raw_alpha/3 for the mean of 3 generations
ridge.tuning: Pooled inner 50/50 task-weighted cached accuracy, larger alpha within 1e-12, then train on H480
ridge.deployment: first exact maximum in physical action order

neural.family: One-hidden-layer width-16 tanh ListNet, an adaptation to 20 physical actions
neural.features: same fold-fit PCA16, StandardScaler and constant as Ridge
neural.supervision: temperature-1 top-one distribution, KL equivalently CE minus the label entropy
neural.paired_intervention: beta=1 standard all-row objective; beta=0 zero weight only on all-action ties, preserving the original question denominator
neural.optimizer: L-BFGS-B; fixed settings in neural.py; paired initialization; train-only objective
neural.deployment: same uniform near-argmax rule tau=1e-8 for both variants

changes: Maximal same-action coupling for expected corrections and damages, with independent draws conditional on differing remaining actions.
gate: Save all fold policies and numerical receipts before scoring. Evaluate the full cached matrix in a separate phase without refitting.
